alt: A haunting sculpted cake diorama of a dilapidated Victorian-style house with asymmetrical windows aglow with amber light, an arched "X"-braced doorway, weathered stone marker, mossy green terrain with cobblestone path, surrounded by gnarled leafless trees under a luminous full moon in warm golds and yellows.

A whimsical sculpted cake of Santa Claus reclining lazily on his back atop fluffy white frosting mimicking snow, his body exaggeratedly round in bright red fondant suit with black belt and boots and gold buckle, expressive blue eyes, rosy cheeks, wide goofy grin, one hand behind his head.

An Easter-themed cake designed as a rustic tree stump with textured bark and light-colored wood grain, topped by a hand-sculpted child in a fluffy white bunny costume with long drooping pink-lined ears and sweet closed-eye smile, beside a wicker basket filled with green shredded paper grass and decorated Easter eggs in purple, yellow, and orange.

A sculpted cake figurine of a werewolf emerging from a rocky cave-like structure, with fur-covered cheeks, pronounced snout with sharp fangs, intense amber eyes, clawed hands gripping the stone archway, set on mossy green flooring with scattered gray stones and gnarled roots.

A Mexican-themed cake featuring a vibrant sombrero as centerpiece with wide brim adorned in bold red, green, and silver patterns against black, ornate silver detailing on the crown, white fondant tassels mimicking fringe, two colorful maracas in yellow, blue, and red, and delicate sugar flowers in blue, green, and white.

A sculpted cake designed as Frankenstein's monster emerging from a rocky tomb with gray stone blocks, the creature's green stitched face and hands bursting through, furrowed brow, sunken eyes, downturned mouth, knotted black hair, articulated fingers gripping the stones, with mossy yellow-green foreground.

A patriotic sculpted cake featuring a cartoonish bald eagle perched atop a realistic hamburger, the eagle wearing a blue top hat with white stars and red-and-white stripes, blue vest patterned with white stars, deep blue wings with textured feather details, talons gripping the burger bun, surrounded by chocolate chip cookies.

A sculpted cake diorama of a gnarled ancient tree emerging from a hollowed-out stone base, rich earthy brown textured bark, dense ruffled green foliage canopy, warm golden light emanating from within the cave-like hollow behind the tree, rough-hewn rock structure in ochre, sienna, and charcoal.

A whimsical cake designed to resemble a melting white candle with thick off-white icing dripping down its sides like molten wax, a thin dark wick protruding from the top, surrounded by artificial autumn leaves in vibrant orange, yellow, and green arranged in a circular pattern on a clear glass plate.

A hyper-realistic sculpted cake of a severed eyeball resting on a pale textured surface, with translucent cloudy sclera veined with red capillaries, striking electric blue iris, deep black pupil with sharp highlight, encircled by a stark white ring, behind it a large bulbous mass of bright saturated red material resembling raw muscle tissue.

A sculpted cake designed as a grotesque anthropomorphic pumpkin head with bulging wide-set red-eyed eyes, broad toothy grin revealing uneven off-white fondant teeth, deeply furrowed brow ridges, rich textured orange and brown skin with realistic creases, twisted green stem, surrounded by hand-painted green ivy leaves on mossy-green platform.

A Thanksgiving-themed cake featuring a large stylized turkey figurine with wide yellow eyes, bright orange beak and wattle, intricately detailed feathers in gray, brown, red, and orange fanning out as tail feathers, perched atop a faux tree stump surrounded by chocolate chip cookies, sugar cookies with white frosting, and small glossy orange pumpkins.

A realistic sculpted cake of roast beef on a white oval platter with deep golden-brown seared exterior, two thick slices revealing rosy-pink medium-rare interior, pooling amber-colored gravy, accompanied by cooked cabbage in pale green and creamy white layers.

A whimsical Halloween sculpted cake featuring a glossy black cat with vivid green eyes and open mouth leaping from behind a bright orange pumpkin forming the upper body, the cat's tail arching dramatically curling above the pumpkin, set on a base resembling a witch's hat in deep purple with white spiderweb patterns.

A St. Patrick's Day sculpted cake figurine of a leprechaun seated on a rustic wooden slice base, wearing a vibrant green suit with textured vest, wide-brimmed green hat with silver band and gold buckle, reddish-brown beard, cheerful animated face, holding a wooden staff and bright green four-leaf clover, red bow tie, brown shoes with gold buckles, scattered gold-painted coins.

A Thanksgiving sculpted cake depicting a scarecrow-like turkey standing in a field of corn — the turkey with brown body, blue eyes, red wattle, yellow beak, green jacket with patchwork details, blue pants, straw hat with white band, wings revealing feathered patterns, surrounded by tall dried corn stalks, chocolate-frosted cake base with translucent fondant autumn border in red, orange, yellow, and green.

A grotesque, hyper-realistic jack-o'-lantern with bulging red eyes, a pig-like snout, and a wide, toothy grin sits on a mossy green base surrounded by ivy leaves, with a small wooden sign reading "day" visible to the left.
An elephant-shaped cake with large ears and white tusks emerges from a round base decorated with red, white, and blue stripes, set against a solid orange background.
A sculpted cake diorama depicts a monstrous reindeer with glowing red eyes standing over a fallen Easter bunny, with an axe embedded in the bunny's head amidst scattered Easter eggs and grass.
A hyper-realistic cake sculpted to resemble a severed green-skinned demon head with red eyes, small horns, and an open mouth, resting on a red cloth inside a silver platter.

caption: Halloween Jack O Lantern Cake
alt: An elaborate Halloween cake features a large orange jack-o'-lantern base topped with a haunted graveyard scene, including a grim reaper, tombstones, and a spooky castle set against a yellow full moon.
A sculpted cake diorama features a snowman with a top hat and scarf standing before a stone cottage with a red door, surrounded by snowy pine trees against a blue backdrop.

caption: Pumpkin Pile-up Cake
alt: A four-tiered cake sculpted to resemble stacked jack-o'-lanterns, each with a unique carved face and green fondant leaves, sits on a textured brown base against a black background.
Two whimsical bunny figurines dressed in green suits and leprechaun hats stand amidst colorful sprinkles and shamrocks, holding golden carrots as part of a festive St. Patrick's Day cake topper.
A small, pale green and white pumpkin rests on a woven orange placemat alongside two ears of colorful Indian corn with yellow, red, and purple kernels.

A whimsical, sculpted cake features a large, white-furred, blue-faced monster character joyfully holding a star-topped Christmas tree and wrapped in colorful Christmas lights, set against a backdrop of icy blue mountains and a snowy landscape.

caption: Autumn Cake
alt: A two-tiered chocolate cake decorated with autumn-themed fondant leaves, acorns, and a framed floral painting topper sits on a marble cake board against a black backdrop.

caption: The Gentlemen Based on a character from “Buffy The Vampire Slayer”
alt: A collage of three photos features a sculpted cake of a pale-skinned monster with red eyes and sharp teeth, dressed in a formal black suit and tie, clutching its head in front of a large clock face, with the text "The Gentlemen" displayed in the upper right corner.

caption: New Years Cake
alt: A festive 2012 New Year's cake decorated with a blue base, white snow, and multiple snowmen wearing colorful party hats, topped with a branch tree displaying the year "2012" in white numerals.

A round cake features a glossy black top and sides adorned with vibrant orange and red floral patterns, accented by gold leaf and black sugar pearls, and crowned with a large, delicate orange flower made from thin, translucent petals.

caption: Penguin and Snowman cake
alt: A rectangular birthday cake decorated with a winter theme features a snowman wearing a top hat, two penguins, and translucent ice cube-shaped letters spelling "HAPPY BIRTHDAY COREY 25" on a blue marbled base.

caption: Holly Holiday Cake
alt: A two-tiered white Christmas cake decorated with green holly leaves and red berries, topped with three large red and gold fondant ornaments.

caption: Turkey Dinner Ham Surprise Cake
alt: A whimsical cake display features a sculpted turkey holding a fork above a pig-shaped pie and various miniature food items, all set against a solid green background.

A detailed fondant cake topper features a smiling scarecrow with curly blonde hair, a red shirt, and a brown hat with a small black crow perched on it, set against a backdrop of colorful autumn leaves.

An elaborate Christmas tree cake features dark green piped frosting branches adorned with red and gold baubles, surrounded at the base by glowing yellow candy lights and resting on a chocolate-dusted plate.
A Halloween display features a carved jack-o'-lantern, a green-skinned witch stirring a cauldron, and an owl perched on a tree branch, all set on a painted green base decorated with autumn leaves.
A round cake decorated with colorful autumn-themed frosting, featuring small orange pumpkins, green and yellow leaves, and dark chocolate spikes arranged on top and around the sides.

A whimsical sculpted cake of a white rabbit with blue eyes and buck teeth balances a stack of pastel-colored, swirled Easter eggs on its head and in its paws while sitting in a bed of bright green Easter grass.
A sculpted cake bust of a silver-colored rabbit-like creature with long ears, glowing white eyes, and a wide, toothy grin, mounted on a black hexagonal base.

A cheerful raccoon wearing a patriotic Uncle Sam top hat and an American flag bowtie stands on a tree stump holding a small US flag, surrounded by red, white, and blue stars against a solid red background.
